_: Thin eyelid skin (the thinnest skin of the body), over orbicularis oculi with almost no subcutaneous fat. Same format as skin.body; only what differs is changed, each with its source. Materials foundation lane 2026-11-07. v2 (SKIN lane 11-07): mechanics moved into deform; its own compliance from its thin stack (no eyelid-specific in vivo modulus was found).

thickness_mm.src: params/skin_layers.json dermis_mm.eyelid (soft_tissue.md R41: eyelid dermis 0.76 mm minimum of sites)

f_blood.src: eyelid skin reads pinker / more violet than the cheek (thin skin over a rich vascular plexus); x2 skin.body, not measured

sat.src: venous plexus under thin skin shows through; a little under skin.body's 0.75

below.v: muscle.skeletal (orbicularis oculi, ~0.5-1 mm) then the orbital septum; almost no fat in front of the septum

n.src: skin_specular.json mapping: F0 = 0.0255 x rho_s / 0.25, rho_s 0.292 -> F0 0.0298 -> n = (1 + sqrt F0) / (1 - sqrt F0) = 1.42

micro_relief._: Fine, dense, crossing lines; no measured Ra for the eyelid found (research/skin_pores_vellus_relief.md:101 lists periorbital relief as NOT FOUND). Kept open.

tack.v: tear-wetted lid margin; lid-to-lid contact is the blink seal (mucosa at the margin)

v.position: near the positive end (gives up electrons): above nylon-class, below polyurethane foam

triboelectric.src: ALPHALAB09 rows 'Nylon, dry skin' +30 and 'Hair, oily skin' +45 nC/J (72 F, 35 % RH); skin is conductive, so metal rubbing cannot charge it

E_kPa.src: FENG22 OCE forearm incl. stratum corneum (small strain)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

compressible_to_fraction.src: a stiff thin shell: thins little under contact (E)

thickness_mm.src: HEADFACE F8 upper eyelid skin 0.57 mm total (75 MHz US, 45 women) less the epidermis; histology dermis 0.76 mm upper medial lid (F9)

E_kPa.src: FENG22 forearm dermis applied: no eyelid modulus found

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: below in this profile: 0.5-1 mm (anatomy, E)

E_kPa.src: 3 x G 4 kPa relaxed muscle (TISSUE g_muscle_relaxed; SOFTTISSUE R25)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: pre-aponeurotic fat pad to the globe, a few mm (E, not measured here)

E_kPa.src: fat.subcutaneous quasi-static ~1 kPa (COMLEY10) for orbital fat (E)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: series stack of compliance_layers: E_eff = T / sum(t_i / E_i) = 1.2 kPa over T 7.32 mm, / T; initial (small-strain) value; each layer stiffens with strain (per-layer stiffening as skin.body)

ramp.src: IPC-style log barrier inside collision_thickness keeps surfaces apart; the tissue's own stiffening (exponential in strain) carries the load beyond it

contact_damping_ratio.src: between thigh 0.14 and calf 0.42 (no lid value)

restitution.src: thin skin over muscle and fat: inside the soft-tissue range of skin.body (0.23-0.64)

response_time_ms.src: QU forearm Cutometer value; no lid value

damping_ratio.src: between thigh 0.14 and calf 0.42 (no lid value)

membrane_stiffness_N_m.src: E_dermis x t = 40 kPa x 0.52 mm: about 0.43 x skin.body's 40 x 1.2 (thinner, so it folds and stretches easily: the lid crease and hooding)

model.src: thin membrane; the GOH fit of skin.body is for back skin

E_kPa.src: skin.body's OCE values applied (no eyelid-specific in vivo set read yet)

stretch.src: JOFA pooled facial areas (Cutometer MPA 580, 72 adults; lid not separated); periorbital R2 / R7 fall with age (Korean lower-lid study, values not retrieved)

conductivity_W_mK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 0.372 W/mK (SD 0.059, 8 studies, range 0.322-0.498); 0.37 kept

heat_capacity_J_kgK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 3390.5 J/kgK (SD 233, 4 studies, 3150-3662)

density_kg_m3.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 1109 kg/m3 (SD 38, n 10, 1100-1125); ICRU44 ~1090: recalled, not re-read

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) from the three ITIS values above, J m-2 K-1 s-1/2 (the 'feels warm/cold' number)

emissivity.src: STEKETEE73 abstract re-read 11-08 (paper paywalled; abstract text via a reproduction): skin 0.98 +/- 0.01, independent of wavelength over the measured 1-14 um; white, black and burnt skin measured (normal = burnt); separate per-pigment values are not given in the abstract
